approval_requests_decision_consistent.name: approval_requests_decision_consistent
approval_requests_decision_consistent.value: ("approval_requests"."state" IN ('approved', 'rejected', 'consumed')) = ("approval_requests"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

asset_versions_sha256_valid.name: asset_versions_sha256_valid
asset_versions_sha256_valid.value: "asset_versions"."sha256" IS NULL OR (length("asset_versions"."sha256") = 64 AND "asset_versions"."sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

derivatives_spec_valid.name: derivatives_spec_valid
derivatives_spec_valid.value: length("derivatives"."canonical_spec") BETWEEN 1 AND 256 AND "derivatives"."canonical_spec" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_.,-]*'

derivatives_lease_consistent.name: derivatives_lease_consistent
derivatives_lease_consistent.value: ("derivatives"."state" = 'generating') = ("derivatives"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "derivatives"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

derivatives_sha256_valid.name: derivatives_sha256_valid
derivatives_sha256_valid.value: "derivatives"."sha256" IS NULL OR (length("derivatives"."sha256") = 64 AND "derivatives"."sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

derivatives_dimensions_positive.name: derivatives_dimensions_positive
derivatives_dimensions_positive.value: ("derivatives"."width" IS NULL OR "derivatives"."width" > 0) AND ("derivatives"."height" IS NULL OR "derivatives"."height" > 0)

derivatives_ready_metadata.name: derivatives_ready_metadata
derivatives_ready_metadata.value: "derivatives"."state" <> 'ready' OR ("derivatives"."storage_object_id" IS NOT NULL AND "derivatives"."size_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "derivatives"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "derivatives"."mime_type" IS NOT NULL AND "derivatives"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

derivatives_terminal_unleased.name: derivatives_terminal_unleased
derivatives_terminal_unleased.value: "derivatives"."state" NOT IN ('ready', 'failed') OR ("derivatives"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "derivatives"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

jobs_lease_consistent.name: jobs_lease_consistent
jobs_lease_consistent.value: ("jobs"."state" = 'running' AND "jobs"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("jobs"."state" <> 'running' AND "jobs"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

storage_objects_sha256_valid.name: storage_objects_sha256_valid
storage_objects_sha256_valid.value: "storage_objects"."sha256" IS NULL OR (length("storage_objects"."sha256") = 64 AND "storage_objects"."sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

storage_objects_available_metadata.name: storage_objects_available_metadata
storage_objects_available_metadata.value: "storage_objects"."state" <> 'available' OR ("storage_objects"."size_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "storage_objects"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "storage_objects"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL)

transform_presets_name_valid.name: transform_presets_name_valid
transform_presets_name_valid.value: length("transform_presets"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "transform_presets"."name" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND substr("transform_presets"."name", 1, 1) GLOB '[a-z]' AND substr("transform_presets"."name", -1, 1) GLOB '[a-z0-9]' AND "transform_presets"."name" NOT GLOB '*--*'

uploads_expected_checksum_valid.name: uploads_expected_checksum_valid
uploads_expected_checksum_valid.value: "uploads"."expected_checksum" IS NULL OR (length("uploads"."expected_checksum") = 64 AND "uploads"."expected_checksum" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

uploads_actual_checksum_valid.name: uploads_actual_checksum_valid
uploads_actual_checksum_valid.value: "uploads"."actual_checksum" IS NULL OR (length("uploads"."actual_checksum") = 64 AND "uploads"."actual_checksum" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
